integrity: All new nonstar-path assertions have an analytic reduction, exact finite separating certificates, algebraic eigenvalue proofs, and full equality analysis. No external mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for odd path orders three, five, and seven only; no conclusions for larger paths, weighted vertices, uncentered averages, or other exponents. The three-vertex constant is previously known.
title: Re-entrant extremizer symmetry for centered Hilbert maximal averages on the first three odd paths
